theme_strategy: Dark Theme (Electric/Neon archetype blended with Swiss High-Contrast). Focused on conveying urgency, speed, and reliability for concert ticket proxy buying.

typography.heading_font: Clash Display, Unbounded, or Anton (Wide, High-Impact Display fonts). MUST NOT use Inter.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl+ tracking-tighter leading-none font-black uppercase
hierarchy.h2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl tracking-tight font-bold uppercase

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise/grain overlay across the page to kill digital flatness.

layouts.bento_grid: Mode A 'Tetris Grid' for the Services section. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Mix spans (e.g., col-span-8 row-span-2 for hero feature, col-span-4 for supporting). Always leave breathing room.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. py-24 or py-32 for sections. Container internal padding p-6 or p-8.
layouts.alignment: Optical alignment. Left-align dense content and forms. Do not center-everything.

motion.scroll: MANDATORY: Use Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling.
motion.kinetic_hero: Framer-motion staggered line-by-line masked reveal on load. Split text into lines/words, animate y-offset, opacity, and slight blur-to-focus.
motion.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee. 'Kinetic Texture' style: Massive outline text (text-8xl+ border-white/20 text-transparent) running slowly in the background.
motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on all buttons (scale up, color shift). Subtle parallax (y offset based on scroll) for the hero background image.

sections.name: Sticky Nav
sections.instructions: Fixed at top (z-50). Crystal Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60, border-b border-white/10. Must contain original SVG logo mark ('Jastipsy' stylized) and primary CTA.

sections.name: Kinetic Hero
sections.instructions: Massive kinetic typography (e.g., 'AMANKAN TIKET KONSERMU', 'TANPA STRES'). Masked line-by-line reveal. Background: real concert photography with heavy overlay (bg-black/50) and subtle parallax on scroll. No purely transparent headers.

sections.name: Editorial Marquee
sections.instructions: Slowly drifting text. e.g., 'WAR TIKET ANTI GAGAL — JASTIPSY — VVIP & REGULAR'

sections.name: Stats & Trust Band
sections.instructions: High contrast typography. E.g., '1000+ Tiket Secured', '99% Success Rate'. Use Cyber Yellow accents.

sections.name: How It Works (3 Steps)
sections.instructions: Step-by-step flow with vertical lines or animated borders (Tracing Beam style). Steps: 1. Pilih Konser, 2. Isi Form & DP, 3. Tiket Secured!

sections.name: Services / Why Us Bento
sections.instructions: Asymmetrical Bento Grid. Cards with dark flat backgrounds or subtle neomorphism (1px white/10 borders). Real concert photography inside clipped/rounded inner frames with duotone or spotlight treatment.

sections.name: Order Request Form
sections.instructions: Shadcn Form. Minimalist, premium inputs (bottom border only or soft dark surfaces). Posts to backend. MUST have data-testid on all inputs and submit.

sections.name: FAQ Accordion
sections.instructions: Shadcn Accordion. Clean, minimal, high contrast on open.

sections.name: Final CTA
sections.instructions: Massive typography. 'SIAP WAR TIKET?'. Primary Button links to Instagram DM (@jastipsy). Hover states must shift color.

sections.name: Footer
sections.instructions: py-24. Darker contrast. Massive 'JASTIPSY' text at text-[10vw] filling the width.

images.description: Dark, cinematic concert crowd with strobe lights. Use with bg-black/60 overlay to ensure text contrast.
Euphoric crowd raising hands. Apply duotone (black and cyber yellow/pink) or spotlight treatment.
Holding a physical ticket. Great for the 'Order/Success' visual context.
Dynamic stage neon strobe lights. Use as a clipped inner image within Bento Grid.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements only.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='submit-order-btn').
Use sonner for toasts, located at /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js.
Note that files are .js (not .tsx) as per the project requirements. Write Shadcn components in .js format.
Do NOT use HTML components for advanced UI (dropdowns, accordions, etc.). Use Shadcn.
Never use purely transparent backgrounds for navbars or overlays if content scrolls behind them; always use crystal glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60).
Copy MUST be strictly in Bahasa Indonesia.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy. Ensure dark colors are used without gradients as the base.
Implement Lenis for smooth scrolling. Wrap main content in a Lenis provider if applicable, or initialize it globally.
For the original SVG logo mark + favicon requirement, generate a clean, bold typographic or vector SVG representing 'Jastipsy' inline in the code.
Always check contrast ratios. Ensure text over images has sufficient text-shadow or a gradient overlay underneath.
